service.description: Shairport Sync AirPlay 2 audio receiver from shairport-sync-desktop: PTP timing for NQPTP (UDP 319 and 320), AirPlay 2 control (TCP 7000), the dynamic ports the audio streams use (TCP and UDP 32768-60999), classic AirPlay (TCP 5000, UDP 6001-6010) and mDNS, so senders can find the receiver.
